name: Default Retirement Plan
description: A baseline retirement plan with reasonable assumptions based on historical data and forward-looking estimates.
_comment: All return rates are REAL (inflation-adjusted). Medical inflation is NOMINAL.

economic._comment: Conservative defaults — use historical medians, not optimistic projections

accounts._comment: Diversified portfolio — adjust to your allocation
accounts.name: 401k - Primary

expenses._comment: Conservative estimate — verify against your actual spending
expenses.name: All Living Expenses

_notes.investment_returns: 7% real is the historical S&P 500 average (1926-2023). Use 6% for conservative planning, 5% for very conservative.
_notes.expense_tracking: Track your actual spending for 6+ months before planning. Boldin-style budgeting often underestimates real spending.
_notes.sequence_risk: The first 5-10 years of retirement are most critical. A bad market early can derail even well-funded plans.
_notes.healthcare: Medical inflation consistently exceeds general inflation by 1-2%. Budget separately for healthcare costs.
_notes.taxes: This model does NOT include taxes in expenses. Add your expected tax burden separately.
